method: Unmodified standard viewer global Terrarium field; bilinear interpolation at pixel centers in the signed building frame. No flattening. Five-meter sampling oversamples the coarse mixed-source DEM.
attribution: Mapzen/Terrain Tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
limitations: Approximate global viewer terrain; not surveyed urban foundation levels. Vegetation and urban surface returns can affect the field.
reviewDatumBasis: One unchanged standard global field sample directly outside the heritage Cowcross entry[40,-128],10.0307664m,defines commonY=0. The previous lower courtyard reference is superseded.
